title: Exposures per sweep against overlap
caption: Exposures a sweep from the sacrum takes at each overlap: the records' values beside the count the simulation's geometry gives for a 9-inch field from the sacrum to T10. More overlap means more exposures and so more links.
status: a record, not a final value

source.notes: The recorded exposures are Reported and each a record, not a final value; the simulated line is Inferred from the geometry alone (field 140 mm, pitch 34 mm lumbar and 27 mm thoracic), and at four bodies it reaches the half-body step floor, since four bodies nearly fill a 9-inch field.
